title: daphne sericea subsp. circassica
intro: Daphne sericea subsp. circassica, commonly known as the Circassian or Caucasian daphne, is a plant species within the Thymelaeaceae family, native to the Caucasus region. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis, and its anti-inflammatory properties, which help alleviate conditions like arthritis. The therapeutic actions of Daphne sericea subsp. circassica include its ability to induce sweating, which can help reduce fever, and its expectorant properties, which facilitate the removal of mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of this plant include daphnin, which is responsible for its toxicity, and other compounds like flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
